name: Heading
description: Semantic heading component rendering h1-h6 with independent typographic sizing. Level controls HTML semantics; size controls visual appearance from the display scale.

level.description: Semantic heading level. Controls the rendered HTML element (h1-h6). Does not control visual size.

size.description: Visual typography scale size. Independent of level. Defaults follow convention: level 1 → display-2xl, 2 → display-xl, 3 → display-lg, 4 → display-md, 5 → display-sm, 6 → text-xl.

weight.description: Font weight. Maps to typography-weight-* tokens.

color.description: Semantic text color token name (e.g. 'color-text-default'). Must be a valid design system token.

do: Use Heading for page and section titles
Always choose a level that reflects document outline order — do not skip heading levels
Use the size prop to achieve the desired visual scale independently of document structure
Pass semantic token names as the color prop value
doNot: Do not use Heading for body text — use the Text component instead
Do not choose a heading level for its visual size — adjust size prop instead
Do not pass raw CSS values as color

accessibility.notes: Heading level directly controls the h1-h6 element. Ensure headings follow a logical document outline. Do not skip levels (e.g. h1 → h3) as this confuses screen reader users navigating by heading.
